montage-camera-and-mechanism: Actual moving cam/cone/bar/summing/crank, pen, coefficient, counter and phase controls plus 2-view/3-view composites need their own >=6 noncoplanar source-to-CAD fit and >=2 held-out anchors per simultaneous physical view. All native frames of this physical montage were decoded/retained; none labelled validated or exempt.

base-plaque-camera-correspondence: Actual nameplate macro shows plate screws, border and cast base. machine-alpha-transitions: Corresponding physical machine remains present during fading/superposition; these are required and cannot use non-machine exemption. Pixel/camera checks not complete.

exact-fade-boundary-localisation: Conservative quarter-second fade bands, uncertainty0.267s; all native samples retained around corresponding-machine fades/cuts, but first/last visible pixel boundary has not been independently localised to one frame.

rigid-camera-identifiability: 211 positive-depth camera fits pass independent source reprojection, but all optimize to3-degree lower FOV bound. Actual moving cam/cone/bar/summing/crank, pen, coefficient, counter and phase controls plus 2-view/3-view composites need their own >=6 noncoplanar source-to-CAD fit and >=2 held-out anchors per simultaneous physical view. All native frames of this physical montage were decoded/retained; none labelled validated or exempt.

Actual nameplate macro shows plate screws, border and cast base. Named CAD plate exists, but source orientation/screw-to-CAD identity and >=6 noncoplanar rigid correspondences are not yet independently established; coplanar plate corners alone do not identify FOV/depth.
Corresponding physical machine remains present during fading/superposition; these are required and cannot use non-machine exemption. Pixel/camera checks not complete.

Conservative quarter-second fade bands, uncertainty0.267s; all native samples retained around corresponding-machine fades/cuts, but first/last visible pixel boundary has not been independently localised to one frame.

211 positive-depth camera fits pass independent source reprojection, but all optimize to3-degree lower FOV bound. Nearly frontal points have insufficient deep visible geometry to establish the physical source camera/occlusion ordering independently; measured camera is a conditional fit, not a true-lens claim. Needs independent rear/depth feature correspondences or source camera calibration.

remainingVisibleFrames.reason: Exact sampled native frame indices and per-view missing camera records, not a claim that unsampled or hidden state is validated.

observationEvidence.nativeFrameTrackingMethod: Shared observe-source.py native Lucas-Kanade; forward/backward <=1px, seed NCC>=0.80, adjacent NCC>=0.90; genuine manual seeds at3,82,123 seconds, no CAD-projected pixels.
observationEvidence.virtualSectionCentreMethod: Independent per-frame chrome silhouette threshold plus chrome/cast R/G zero crossing from actual source image; section centres NEVER optical-flow tracked.
observationEvidence.cameraModelLimit: Nearly frontal source correspondences are shallow-depth. Free-FOV fit can reach parameter bound while independently held-out source reprojection remains within38.4px; not evidence that the true physical lens was that FOV.

unmappedSourceFeatures.description: Actual base nameplate four screw-head centres, orientation not uniquely mapped to named CAD fasteners. Candidate native CAD parts frame/fillister-screw-1..4; pixels are observed but are NOT fit/check truth until correspondence resolved.
